title: Thrive With Type 1 Diabetes 2026
official: Intervention to Thrive With Type 1 Diabetes 2026
summary: This study aims to learn whether a cognitive behavioral intervention can improve lifestyle and glucose targets for adults with type 1 diabetes.

interventions.name: Attention Control Enhanced Usual Care (EUC) Arm

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 31 to 75 years
* Type 1 Diabetes for at least 1 year
* One or more sleep health dimensions are out of range

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English speaking
* Recent night shift work or transmeridian travel
* Life-limiting illness
